text:
maria (CS): Heads-up: EmeraldHealth is seeing spike in p99 embed latency and ~1% 5xxs since 12:08 UTC. Customer is pushing high traffic -> SLA risk. They asked for ETA on a mitigation within 1h. tagging SRE/Platform. @cami @noah

cami (SRE): copying logs + quick checks — can you paste a sample error id and approximate request size? also any recent rollout?

maria (CS): error id: EH-2026-4123, batches are avg 4k tokens, traffic surge after a marketing event. No platform rollout on our side in the last 6h.

cami (SRE): ok. initial guess: KV cache pressure + bursty seq length. plan: short-term fallback to dedicated pool + clear some shared caches. noah, do we have headroom on dedicated-pool-7?

noah (Platform): dedicated-pool-7 currently at 70% — we can burst to 100% by scaling nodes, but it takes ~6-8m to warm. alternative: route a % of emerald traffic to quantized model variant (lower latency) while we scale.

raj (Oncall): I can trigger autoscale and do an emergency bump. Will also add a temporary rate-limit for free-tier keys to reduce noise.

deploy-bot: alert: emeraldhealth-prod p99_latency > 1200ms (5m avg) — incident created #INC-2026-EMRLD

cami (SRE): proposed immediate steps (1) start autoscale bump (raj) (2) route 20% traffic to fallback model variant (noah) (3) run cache trim on shared KV (cami) (4) post an ETA and check in 30m with customer.

noah (Platform): config snippet I'm about to apply:
```
route:
  match: customer=emeraldhealth
  rollout:
    - variant: quantized-lowlat
      weight: 20
    - variant: standard
      weight: 80
fallback_pool: dedicated-pool-7
```
I'll canary at 20% now.

raj (Oncall): running scale command now:
```
kubectl scale deployment/dedicated-pool-7 --replicas=6 -n inference
```
Estimating warm-up ~7m.

cami (SRE): running cache trim on shared-kv:
```
redis-cli -h shared-kv-01 EVAL "return redis.call('FLUSHDB')" 0
```
(do not run this in prod without owner ok) — I'm running a targeted prefix delete instead.

maria (CS): sharing ETA back to customer: "We are routing a portion of your traffic to a low-latency variant and scaling dedicated capacity now — expect visible improvement within 10m; we'll follow up in 30m with metrics."

noah (Platform): canary metrics look good so far — 20% quantized variant p99 ~420ms vs standard ~1150ms. No increased error rate.

raj (Oncall): dedicated pool replicas up and registering. p95 improved, p99 trending down.

cami (SRE): action items assigned: raj -> finish scale and monitor autoscale logs; noah -> keep canary at 20% and prepare rollback plan; cami -> KV trimming and watch tail latencies + alerts. I'll own incident coordination and post a follow-up thread in 30m.

maria (CS): customer acknowledged. thanks team. :pray:

cami (SRE): quick note — if p99 doesn't drop under 800ms in 30m we'll escalate to model team for an inference-optimized compilation patch and prepare a full reroute to dedicated pool (~100%): owner noah.

noah (Platform): ack. prepping runbook steps and a dry-run for full reroute.

cami (SRE): closing loop for now. next update at 176555 (in ~30m)"
